name: Loving Relationships
overview: Scripture reveals that loving relationships are grounded in God's design for unity and holiness. Genesis 2:24 establishes the sacred bond of marriage as a man leaving his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh. Leviticus 18:22 upholds God's moral standards by forbidding relationships that deviate from His intended order. Ultimately, the greatest demonstration of love is found in John 3:16, where God’s sacrificial love through Christ offers eternal life to all who believe.
